public_definitions: Review the urban water-supply dashboard, identify the largest urban water-supply contribution source, then route that source record to escalated contribution review.
Use the dashboard to determine which urban water-supply source is the largest contribution source for this routing decision.
Largest urban water-supply contribution source is defined as the source with the highest reported supply share (%).
